https://studios.wearebraindead.com/movie: Originally broadcast on late-night Los Angeles television between 1985 and 1988, Eternity’s Pillar is Alice Coltrane’s rarely seen series blending devotional music, meditation, and spiritual teachings. This special screening presents four newly restored episodes from the Coltrane archive, offering a rare glimpse into the visionary artist’s extraordinary creative and spiritual practice.
CAM and FACES OF DEATH come together for a special double feature, followed by an in-person Q&A with director Daniel Goldhaber and writer Isa Mazzei.

To win the right to marry his love, the beautiful princess Andromeda, and fulfil his destiny, half-God-half-mortal Perseus must complete various tasks including taming Pegasus, capturing Medusa’s head and battling the feared Kraken.
Two young men seek the solitude of the country; their peace is disturbed when a set of random occurrences suggest to their susceptible minds a pattern with sinister meanings.
A man struggles with memories of his past, including a wife he cannot remember, in a nightmarish world with no sun and run by beings with telekinetic powers who seek the souls of humans.

Deep Water , Adrian Lyne’s powerfully sexy, witty, and intoxicating return to the erotic thriller, finally receives its theatrical premiere. Lyne will join Hollywood Entertainment in person for a very special evening—including some unprecedented interactive surprises!
It's not where you start - It's where you start again.

Between pandemics, people’s revolts and male institutions, this period film cheekily combines fantastic psychedelia and handmade sets. Inspired by the life story of Julian of Norwich, a 14th-century mystic and the first woman to write a book in English.

Brain Dead Studios presents FINAL FANTASY: THE SPIRITS WITHIN , preceded by a special seminar presented by filmmaker Heather Landsman exploring the film’s ambitious creation, groundbreaking technology, and infamous legacy.
Flowers For Lev screening with Alan Ruck Q+A

After returning home from the Vietnam War, veteran Jacob Singer struggles to maintain his sanity. Plagued by hallucinations and flashbacks, Singer rapidly falls apart as the world and people around him morph and twist into disturbing images. His girlfriend, Jezzie, and ex-wife, Sarah, try to help, but to little avail. Even Singer’s chiropractor friend, Louis, fails to reach him as he descends into madness.

In a world of black and white, there is only color, and for friends Vinz (Vincent Cassel) , Hubert (Hubert Koundé), and Saïd (Saïd Taghmaoui) — that color is blue. Armed with a gun, the trio set out on a 24-hour trek through the banlieue districts of Paris in the wake of a clash with the authorities which has left one man in the hospital and three hurtling towards an explosive conclusion. Shot with the idea that the” film should be banned,” Mathieu Kassovitz’s no-holds-barred look of France in the grip of racial tension and fear caused a sensation upon release, and later became an international arthouse smash and a landmark of modern French cinema. Is Paris burning? You bet.

Set in a magnificent villa near a sun-drenched St. Tropez, lovers Jean-Paul and Marianne are spending a happy, lazy summer holiday. Their only concern is to gratify their mutual passion – until the day when Marianne invites her former lover and his beautiful teenage daughter to spend a few days with them. From the first moment, a certain uneasiness and tension begin to develop between the four, which soon escalates in a dangerous love-game.
Luo Hongwu returns to Kaili, the hometown from which he fled many years ago. He begins the search for the woman he loved and whom he has never been able to forget.
Join us at Brain Dead Studios in LA for a screening of the upcoming short film MIDNIGHT DROP , presented by Super Athletic Film Co. and Sound & Fury.

A small group of cosmic explorers, including a woman, leaves Earth to start a new civilization. They do not realize that within themselves they carry the end of their own dream. They die one by one, while their children revert to a primitive native culture, creating new myths and a new god.

People mysteriously start receiving voicemail messages from their future selves, in the form of the sound of them reacting to their own violent deaths, along with the exact date and time of their future death, listed on the message log. The plot thickens as the surviving characters pursue the answers to this mystery which could save their lives.
Patrick Shiroishi Trio Live
Brain Dead Studios presents TROMA — a double feature celebrating two of Troma’s most depraved cult classics.

When larcenous real estate clerk Marion Crane goes on the lam with a wad of cash and hopes of starting a new life, she ends up at the notorious Bates Motel, where manager Norman Bates cares for his housebound mother.

A daredevil driver is determined to compete in Redline, the most popular race in the galaxy. The race only occurs every five years, but in order to participate he must overcome the mafia, the government and even love.
Celebrating Our 20th Anniversary! Saturday, August 22 Doors: 12:00 PM  |  Showtime: 12:30 PM Mystery Feature Screenings of...

In the outskirts of Tokyo, a poor but close-knit group living on the fringes of society survives through shoplifting and odd jobs. When Osamu and his son take in a neglected young girl, their already fragile existence begins to unravel. As the family grows attached to her, buried secrets surface, forcing them to confront the true meaning of love, belonging, and what makes a family.
Sound and Fury presents of Jawbreaker: an Anti-Cimex Documentary with Q+A by Director Tomas Haglund moderated by Zed Cutsinger of So You Did A Thing Podcast

Rootless Hungarian émigré Willie (John Lurie), his pal Eddie (Richard Edson), and visiting sixteen-year-old cousin Eva (Eszter Balint) always manage to make the least of any situation, whether aimlessly traversing the drab interiors and environs of New York City, Cleveland, or an anonymous Florida suburb. With its delicate humor and dramatic nonchalance, Jim Jarmusch’s one-of-a-kind minimalist masterpiece, _Stranger Than Paradise_, forever transformed the landscape of American independent cinema.

When Isabelle and Theo invite Matthew to stay with them, what begins as a casual friendship ripens into a sensual voyage of discovery and desire in which nothing is off limits and everything is possible.
When an unsuspecting town newcomer is drawn to local blood fiends, the Frog brothers and other unlikely heroes gear up to rescue him.

When an arranged marriage brings Ada and her spirited daughter to the wilderness of nineteenth-century New Zealand, she finds herself locked in a battle of wills with both her controlling husband and a rugged frontiersman to whom she develops a forbidden attraction.

Three friends, 12-year-old boys Dug, Mel, and Fatt, go camping in the desert with Dug’s older brother Wyatt and his girlfriend Mary. When the group stops at a gas station, the owner Duana tells them about The Night Child, a creature she claims lives in the desert and took her younger brother twenty-five years ago. They quickly dismiss the story as an old urban legend, but once they arrive in the desert and set up camp, things get weird.

This is Buzz is a documentary by director Mark Pellington that explores the fast-paced, influential 1990 MTV collage series Buzz, serving as a look back at an early, radical precursor to modern internet and meme culture.

Construction worker Douglas Quaid’s obsession with the planet Mars leads him to visit Recall, a company that manufactures memories. When his memory implant goes wrong, Doug can no longer be sure what is and isn’t reality.

Valerie, a Czechoslovakian teenager living with her grandmother, is blossoming into womanhood, but that transformation proves secondary to the effects she experiences when she puts on a pair of magic earrings. Now seeing the world around her in a different light, Valerie must endure her sexual awakening while attempting to discern reality from fantasy as she encounters lecherous priest Gracian, a vampire-like stranger and otherworldly carnival folk.

We Direct Music Videos is thrilled to present Volume 10 of The Directors Series. This time, our guest is icon of the medium Mark Pellington. Through his celebrated work for artists like Pearl Jam, U2, Foo Fighters, The Fray, Nine Inch Nails, The Flaming Lips, Alice in Chains, Public Enemy, INXS, Leonard Cohen, and numerous others, Mark has crafted a highly influential, completely singular style. Join us for a program of music videos selected by Mark Pellington, alongside a career-spanning discussion.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/a-g: Head out on a road trip of goofing proportions in this very 90s animated dad joke! An endearing modern-day story about how the lovable Goof bonds with his teenage son Max on a hilarious cross-country road trip. En route to the ol’ fishing hole, they find themselves up to their floppy ears in misadventure! A movie for the goofball in all of us featuring one of the most epically 90s animated musical sequences ever!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/a-h: John, Paul, George, Ringo, and Paul’s grandfather bring Beatlemania to the big screen in Richard Lester’s 1964 pop fantasia A Hard Day’s Night . More than a concert film or jukebox musical, Lester’s revolutionary, freewheeling masterpiece captures the swinging ’60s sensibility with an infectious, hilarious, and toe-tapping adventure. A snapshot of the Beatles when they were “bigger than Jesus,” A Hard Day’ s Night is a post-modern delight that introduced the world to a new kind of pop star, one that would not be defined by genre or haircuts. The band’s lightning-quick wits continue to win over crowds with their irreverent sense of humor and, yes, indelible songs. Don’t get stuck trying to watch this one at home, with a pathetic soundbar struggling to keep up with Ringo’s beat. Hear A Hard Day’s Night on speakers that won’t let you down. “Can’t Be Me Love” on Vidiots’ sound system is worth the price of admission. Trust us.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/a-v: Bond is back, and this time he’s up against Christopher Walken and the iconic Grace Jones in this Roger Moore-era 007 installment. A newly-developed microchip designed by Zorin Industries for the British Government that can survive the electromagnetic radiation caused by a nuclear explosion has landed in the hands of the KGB. James Bond must find out how and why. His suspicions soon lead him to big industry leader Max Zorin who forms a plan to destroy his only competition in Silicon Valley by triggering a massive earthquake in the San Francisco Bay.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/ali: If you’re like us, you could definitely use some Ellen Ripley in your life right now, and we’re ready to give you what you need! Experience the terror with the first chilling chapter of the Alien saga, directed by Ridley Scott and starring Sigourney Weaver in her breakout performance as the eternally bad-ass Ripley. When the crew of the space-tug Nostromo responds to a distress signal from a barren planet, they discover a mysterious life form that breeds within human hosts. The acid-blooded extraterrestrial proves to be the ultimate adversary as crew members battle to stay alive and prevent the deadly creature from reaching Earth. No one can hear you scream in space, but we certainly will at Vidiots.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/ame: Against political resistance and industry skepticism, Luis Valdez pushes Chicano storytelling from the fields to the film screen with Zoot Suit and La Bamba , crafting iconic works that challenge, celebrate, and expand America’s story.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/be-: Vidiots and our friends and Founding Members at Partizan are thrilled to welcome legendary filmmaker Michel Gondry and more special guests for a special screening of the ultimate video store comedy Be Kind Rewind !
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/bey: Our evening of epic epicness continues with a special screening of Russ Meyer’s sexy psychedelic cinematic freakout Beyond the Valley of the Dolls introduced by Edgar Wright !
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/bob: Vidiots is thrilled to welcome screen icons Elliott Gould and Dyan Cannon for a special screening of Paul Mazursky’s Bob & Carol & Ted & Alice !
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/bor: With a special introduction from the man responsible for Borat’s speedo – Costume Designer Jason Alper !
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/bou: Join us in the microcinema for one of the most unique animated feature films of recent history – Maeriem Bennani’s intensely personal, singular, and genuine Bouchra . Wrestling with writer’s block for her first film, Bouchra, a queer Moroccan jackal living in NYC, starts having difficult yet overdue phone calls with her mother in Casablanca that begin influencing the project. Balancing the precarity of working as an artist, the rift in her cultural identity and an array of romantic interests, Bouchra’s emotional reckoning becomes her path to expression. Juxtaposing decidedly absurd animation choices with the realism of her characters and dialogue, Bennani creates an asbolutely unique vision of artistry and queer identity.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/bre: A sequel that is best remembered for its subtitle, this 80s breakdancing cult classic is about to turn your Friday night into the ultimate 80s dance off! The best breakdancers on the block are poppin’ and lockin’ their way to good karma when they use their powers of dance to take on a greedy developer that threatens their beloved community center with strip-mallification. The fashion, the dance moves, the 80s cheese, the Cannon Films moxie, it’s all in such abundance, you’ll be doing head-spins on the way back to your car! So bring your crew, pop on your knee pads, and get ready for the ultimate in 80s dance cinema!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/can: Vidiots can’t wait to party with Writer/Directors Deborah Kaplan and Harry Elfont at a special screening of their quintessential 90s teen classic Can’t Hardly Wait, and you’re invited!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/cat: Our fuzzy overlords return to the big screen! Vidiots is purrfectly enthralled to bring back the cutest kitty compilation ever! CatVideoFest is a compilation reel of the latest and best cat videos culled from countless hours of unique submissions and sourced animations, music videos, and classic internet powerhouses. CatVideoFest is a joyous communal experience, only available in theaters, and raises money for cats in need through partnerships with local cat charities, animal welfare organizations, and shelters to best serve cats in the area.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/chr: A meeting of two of the greatest minds in horror, this vehicular monster movie combines the sentient machines of Stephen King with the uneasy vibes of John Carpenter for an 80s horror classic in high gear. Nerdy high schooler Arnie Cunningham falls for Christine, a rusty 1958 Plymouth Fury, and becomes obsessed with restoring the classic automobile to her former glory. As the car changes, so does Arnie, whose newfound confidence turns to arrogance behind the wheel of his exotic beauty. Arnie’s girlfriend Leigh and best friend Dennis reach out to him, only to be met by a Fury like no other. Featuring Vidiots’ forever legend Harry Dean Stanton as a wisened, chain-smoking police detective trying to solve a string of mysterious homicides that appear to be the work of a motorpsycho.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/com: Get your bazookas ready for a non-stop action bonanza as Schwarzenegger takes on an army of mercenaries to save his daughter (none other than Alyssa Milano!) by brawling in the mall, and blowing up as much of LA as he can! One of the best popcorn blockbusters of the 1980s, Rae Dawn Chong and the Governator team up for action, for fun, and for revenge in this bad-ass specatacular. John Matrix, the former leader of a special commando strike force that always got the toughest jobs done, is forced back into action when his young daughter is kidnapped by a group of assassins led by ultra villain Bennett (Vernon Wells). To find her, Matrix has to fight his way through an array of punks, killers, one of his former commandos, and a fully equipped private army. With the help of a feisty stewardess and an old friend, Matrix has only a few hours to overcome his greatest challenge: finding his daughter before she’s killed. Join us for all the fun as we watch this explosive banger big and loud!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/dan: Get ready for all the opulence, the intrigue, the seduction, and the betrayal of Stephen Frears’ lush and salacious period piece. In 18th century France, Marquise de Merteuil asks her ex-lover Vicomte de Valmont to seduce the future wife of another ex-lover of hers in return for one last night with her. Yet things don’t go as planned. Nominated for seven Academy Awards and winner of Best Costumes, Art Direction, and Adapted Screenplay, and starring some of the best actors of any generation, this is one gorgeously sexy game of cat and mouse best watched in all its luxurious glory on our big beautiful screen!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/dea: Our celebration of the life and legacy of Sam Neill continues with the unnerving slow burn Aussie thriller Dead Calm .
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/dia: Luis Buñuel’s biting social satire starring the luminous Jeanne Moreau! Celestine (Jeanne Moreau) takes a job as a chambermaid in the country only to discover that the family she’s been hired to serve has a strange mélange of sexual and political predilections.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/dir: Nobody puts Baby in a corner! Spend your summer vacation in the Catskills with one of the most beloved coming-of-age love stories of all time. Put on your dancing shoes and fall in love with Patrick Swayze all over again (as if you ever fell out of love with him)! It’s the Summer of ’63 and well-to-do, do-gooder Baby is vacationing with her family at a swank summer resort when she’s swept away by an other-side-of-the-tracks dance instructor who opens her eyes and her heart. Don your dancing shoes and come prepared for a movie-going experience you’ll only find at Vidiots (surprises will abound), you know you can’t resist these hungry eyes!

The con is on with Frank Oz’s masterful dark comedy classic with absolute legends Steve Martin and Michael Caine! At a luscious coastal resort two expert con men go head to head and toe to toe in a match to see who can swindle an heiress out of her money and claim the resort for their own private hunting ground. Steve Martin turns on one of his most ridiculous performances against the suave and debonaire coolness always exuded by Michael Caine resulting in 24 carat comedy gold! Bring your best frenemy to ease the tension through uproarious laughter!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/dre: Join us for a full day of killer films that inspired Jane Schoenbrun’s Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma presented by our friends at MUBI.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/enc: One of Disney’s most delightful and beloved films of the 21st century, the animated fantasy Encanto is overflowing with unforgettable characters, colorful adventures, and hum-worthy tunes. The Madrigals are a family living in a mystical house in the mountains of Colombia, and each member of the clan has their own special power — all except for teen daughter Mirabel (voice of Stephanie Beatriz), still disappointed that she’s the only ordinary one. But when their magical world faces a new threat, Mirabel seizes her chance to be a hero after all. María Cecilia Botero, John Leguizamo, Mauro Castillo, Jessica Darrow, Diane Guerrero, and Wilmer Valderrama also lend their voices, and Lin-Manuel Miranda contributes eight original songs (including the impossibly catchy “We Don’t Talk About Bruno”). Sing along with this enchanted musical with your little ones, or your Pixar-loving adult besties!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/far: Join Vidiots and our friends at CAPE for the new 4K Restoration of Chen Kaige’s ravishing Palme d’Or winning masterpiece Farewell My Concubine .
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/fil: Join us in the microcinema for one of the best films of the year and a masterwork of international cinema – Rafael Manuel’s phenomenally composed deadpan social satire Filipiñana . With jaw-dropping shot composition, immaculate color coding, a biting and satiric wit, and a slow deliberateness that builds to a shocking ending, this is a dazzler on another level with class consciousness to boot. If Ruben Ostlund and Wes Anderson had a Filipino baby, it still wouldn’t be as good as Filipiñana ! Don’t miss your chance to see this stunner on a big screen!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/for: Join us in our microcinema for the haunted Spanish vacation your summer was missing with this tender and otherworldly film of loss, ghosts, and grief from filmmaker Lucía Aleñar Iglesias. Cata will see her summer vacation disrupted by the absurd and sudden death of her grandmother, which only she witnesses. Her grief shifts when she casually turns to play pretend, transforming into the deceased. What begins with a game of dress-up will blur the lines of reality and family roles. With absolutely stunning cinematography (with an incredible use of framing), the exquisite backdrop of the Catalonian coastline, and a breathy and ethereal vibe, this is one of the loveliest ghost stories you may ever see.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/fun: Hello Gorgeous! There’s no better time to revel in the glory of Barbra than in her Oscar-winning performance in William Wyler’s masterful musical biopic Funny Girl ! In this bittersweet, iconic musical classic, the vibrant and beautiful young Fanny Brice (Barbra Streisand) starts out as a bit player on the New York City vaudeville stage, but works her way up to stardom on the Great White Way with help from theater impresario Florenz Ziegfeld while struggling with her relationship with her suave, imprisoned businessman husband, Nicky Arnstein (Omar Sharif). Nominated for eight Academy Awards and considered one of the best musicals of all time – be one of the luckiest people in the world and don’t miss Streisand in her full glory on our big screen and blasted in stereo!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/guy: Join us for a big screen criminal musical bonanza starring the legendary Frank Sinatra and Marlon Brando! Featuring iconic Frank Loesser tunes like Luck Be a Lady Tonight and Sit Down, You’re Rockin’ the Boat performed by an all-star cast that includes Marlon Brando and Frank Sinatra, Guys and Dolls is a classic Hollywood musical; a high-stakes story of New York’s gambling underworld that’s light on its feet and sweeter than a round of dulce de leche.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/hon: Rick Moranis is nobody’s Father of the Year as he takes science one step too far and miniaturizes his whole family. The scientist father of a teenage girl and boy accidentally shrinks his and two other neighborhood teens to the size of insects. Now the teens must fight diminutive dangers as the father searches for them. A microscopic adventure to share with the whole family!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/hun: Vidiots remembers the life and legacy of the incredible Sam Neill with an especially heartwarming screening of Taika Waititi’s Hunt for the Wilderpeople .
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/i-w: Los Angeles indie legend Gregg Araki’s newest absurd comedy is a raunchy, kinky delight and it’s steaming up our microcinema in all its eye-popping, kink-positive, raucously funny glory! When fresh-faced Elliot lands an exciting job for renowned artist, icon and provocateur Erika Tracy, his fantasies come true as Erika taps him to become her sexual muse. But Elliot soon finds himself out of his depth as Erika takes him on a journey more profound than he ever could have imagined, into a world of sex, obsession, power, betrayal and murder.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/int: Join us in an everlasting eternity with Neil Jordan’s devastatingly sexy Anne Rice adaptation! Born as an 18th-century lord, Louis is now a bicentennial vampire, telling his story to an eager biographer. Suicidal after the death of his family, he meets Lestat, a vampire who persuades him to choose immortality over death and become his companion. Eventually, gentle Louis resolves to leave his violent maker, but Lestat guilts him into staying by turning a young girl — whose addition to the “family” breeds even more conflict. With stunning costume and art direction, a jaw-dropping performance from an 11 year-old Kirsten Dunst, a healthy dose of homoeroticism, and so many sexy, brooding vampires, we can’t wait to sink our teeth into this lush bloodthirsty classic on glorious celluloid!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/jac: Johnny Knoxville and the gang return for one final fling at the big screen. Featuring all-new stunts and stupidity along with the greatest hits and biggest laughs from the past, jackass: best and last is a joyously raucous celebration of all the mischievous camaraderie that you’ve come to love and expect from these idiots over the past 25 years. So, grab your dumb little buddies, raise your glasses, and come experience the cinematic event that promises to be the last time you’ll ever laugh this hard in a theatre.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/jaz: Join Vidiots and Jazz is Dead for the perfect summer concert film. Filmed at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival in Rhode Island and directed by world-renowned photographer Bert Stern, Jazz on a Summer’s Day features intimate performances by an all-star line-up of musical legends including Louis Armstrong, Thelonious Monk, Gerry Mulligan, Anita O’Day, Dinah Washington, and closes with a beautiful rendition of The Lord’s Prayer by Mahalia Jackson at midnight to usher in Sunday morning. The film has been beautifully and extensively restored in 4K from the best surviving vault elements by IndieCollect.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/jur: Vidiots celebrates the life and legacy of the incredible Sam Neill with a special screening of the iconic Jurassic Park on glorious celluloid!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/kil: Your Saturday night just got a whole lot more kick ass as Quentin Tarantino’s Kill Bill ignites our big screen with an onslaught of celluloid action! A former assassin, known simply as The Bride (Uma Thurman), wakes from a coma four years after her jealous ex-lover Bill (David Carradine) attempts to murder her on her wedding day. Fueled by an insatiable desire for revenge, she vows to get even with every person who contributed to the loss of her unborn child, her entire wedding party, and four years of her life. After devising a hit list, The Bride sets off on her quest, enduring unspeakable injury and unscrupulous enemies. So, hop in your p***ywagon and get ready for a maelstrom of revenge so bad ass and bloody, you might never recover!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/la-: The circus is in town, and with the legendary Federico Fellini helming the big top with the extraordinary Giulietta Masina at center stage, you know you’re in for a magnificent show!  Maestro Federico Fellini’s La Strada launched both him and his luminous wife Giulietta Masina to international stardom. Gelsomina (Masina) is sold by her mother into the employ of Zampanò (Anthony Quinn), a brutal strongman in a traveling circus. When Zampanò encounters an old rival in highwire artist the Fool (Richard Basehart), his fury is provoked to its breaking point. With La Strada Fellini left behind the familiar signposts of Italian neorealism for a poetic fable of love and cruelty, evoking brilliant performances and winning the hearts of audiences and critics worldwide. A phenomenal early work from one of Italy and the world’s greatest masters of cinema.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/loc: With writer/director Sabrina Greco in person at both screenings! Friday, August 14th Greco will be in conversation with Micah Gottlieb of Mezzanine Cinema and the Los Angeles Festival of Movies .
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/mad: Maddie’s Secret is comedian, writer, and actor John Early’s critically acclaimed directorial debut starring himself as Maddie, a plucky dishwasher who leaps to viral superstardom at a trendy food content creation company. While her life seems picturesque — complete with an adoring husband (Eric Rahill), ride-or-die best friend (Kate Berlant) and a cupboard full of woman-owned ethically-sourced chili crisp to boot — mounting professional pressures threaten to reawaken a hidden secret from her troubled past. A pitch-perfect blend of satire, melodrama, daring tonal shifts and intimate performances, the film marks a bold new voice in contemporary cinema.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/mag: Is it hot in here, or is it just Matt Bomer? Get ready to go wild with Mike and the boys in the original thirst trap throwdown! Would anyone have guessed that Steven Soderbergh would have taken on the male-exotic dance scene with such zeal? With Channing Tatum and a cavalcade of the sexiest men in America stripping down to their skivvies, it’s no wonder this beefcake bonanza launched the thirst of millions worldwide and led to a jock-thrusting empire that anyone can get behind! You can leave your dollar bills at home, we’ve got the money gun prepped and primed for this sexy fun night for anyone who’s feeling a little thirsty with all this heat!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/man: Before Silence of the Lambs , Michael Mann first introduced the cinema world to infamous cannibal Hannibal Lecter in this sizzling and stylish thriller. FBI criminal profiler Will Graham (William Petersen) is called out of early retirement to assist on a serial murder case involving a killer known as the “Tooth Fairy”. Graham enlists the help of imprisoned serial killer — and cannibal — Dr. Hannibal Lecktor (Brian Cox), who is the reason Graham took an early retirement. Soon, Graham and the FBI are entangled in a deadly cat-and-mouse game between the Tooth Fairy, Lecktor and an interfering journalist.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/mar: Featuring a conversation with filmmaker Sasha Waters after the August 12th screening!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/mil: Co-presented by our friends at American Cinema Editors and featuring a conversation with editor Michael Miller moderated by John Venzon . Also featuring a book signing of Miller’s book Developing the Editor’s Eye .
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/moa: Sing along with this modern animated classic of a powerful girl pursuing her destiny and identity! Moana is on a daring mission to save her people, sailing out in the seas of the mighty Pacific with determination. Along the way she meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her towards her goal of becoming a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity. With a fun and inspiring soundtrack that includes tracks by Lin-Manuel Miranda, here’s your chance to belt out your favorite tunes with folks who love it as much as you do!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/mon: KCRW , Vidiots , and HBO Documentary Films invite you to a special advance screening of Monsters of God followed by a conversation with director and executive producer Eric Goode , executive producer Jeremy McBride , producer Tom Petersen , and subjects Mike Van Nostrand and Tom Crutchfield , moderated by Jason Segel .
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/mys: Vidiots is thrilled to welcome back legendary indie filmmaker Gregg Araki for a special screening of Mysterious Skin including a conversation with Araki and actor Joseph Gordon-Levitt!

We’ve got your Saturday night cooking in the oven with this tasty and endearing coming-of-age classic from the late 80s starring Julia Roberts in her breakout role! For Daisy Araujo, her sensible sister Kat and their wisecracking friend Jojo, the summer after high school is a summer they can never forget. Slinging pizza at a local restaurant, the three girls share their hopes, dreams and plans for escaping their small town. A warm and genuine romantic comedy that never leaves you hungry, Mystic Pizza is still cinematic comfort food for your soul!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/net: I’m mad as Hell and I’m not going to take it anymore! One of the greatest satiric thrillers of all time, Sidney Lumet’s paranoid masterpiece Network has never stopped being relevant in an ever-increasingly corporate world. The UBS network is ready to retire their anchorman Howard Beale after 25 years. In an on-air tirade, Beale announces his plan to kill himself on TV. When ratings sky-rocket, Beale’s angry prophet routine becomes big business, and UBS decides to go even harder into extreme programming. Savagely funny, soul-shatteringly prescient, and with unbelievable performances from Peter Finch and Faye Dunaway, it’s easy to see how this film won 4 Oscars and continues to stay timely – 50 years later.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/o-b: We’ve got your Odyssey right here with Ethan and Joel Coen’s endlessly entertaining reimagining of the ancient myth in the 1930s Deep South. This sepia tinted journey sings with crackling dialogue, stunning Roger Deakins cinematography, and a Grammy winning soundtrack. Three convicts escape a chain gang in Mississippi and set out to uncover buried treasure, all the while encountering one mythical task after another. A comic masterpiece from two of cinema’s most brilliant siblings, join Ulysses and the (chain) gang for one epic adventure on our big screen!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/onc: Vidiots remembers the life and talent of the great musician and actor Glen Hansard with a special screening of the delightful musical romance Once .
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/one: What’s better than one puppy? Over one hundred puppies of course! And who would ever want to hurt dozens of puppies? An evil fashionista named Cruella De Vil that’s who. But the four-legged parents of these adorable spotted babies aren’t going to let the villainess or her criminal henchmen make off with their precious furballs. Bring your own adorable litter of little ones and relish this furry fable all over again!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/per: Vidiots remembers the life, legacy, and creativity of the extraordinary Marjane Satrapi with a special screening of the animated masterpiece Persepolis!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/pon: Dive into this breathtaking and heartwarming adventure from the legendary Studio Ghibli, and Academy Award-winning director Hayao Miyazaki. When Sosuke, a young boy who lives on a clifftop overlooking the sea, rescues a stranded goldfish named Ponyo, he discovers more than he bargained for. Ponyo is a curious, energetic young creature who yearns to be human, but even as she causes chaos around the house, her father, a sorcerer, schemes to return Ponyo to the sea. Loosely based on Hans Christian Andersen’s classic fairy tale The Little Mermaid , Miyazaki’s breathtaking, imaginative world is brought to life!

Dive into this breathtaking and heartwarming adventure from the legendary Studio Ghibli, and Academy Award-winning director Hayao Miyazaki. When Sosuke, a young boy who lives on a clifftop overlooking the sea, rescues a stranded goldfish named Ponyo, he discovers more than he bargained for. Ponyo is a curious, energetic young creature who yearns to be human, but even as she causes chaos around the house, her father, a sorcerer, schemes to return Ponyo to the sea. Loosely based on Hans Christian Andersen’s classic fairy tale The Little Mermaid , Miyazaki’s breathtaking, imaginative world is brought to life with an all-star cast, featuring the voices of Cate Blanchett, Noah Cyrus, Matt Damon, Tina Fey, Frankie Jonas, Cloris Leachman, Liam Neeson, Lily Tomlin, and Betty White.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/pos: Vidiots remembers the life and legacy of the incredible Sam Neill with a special screening of Andrzej Żuławski’s twisted body horror Possession .
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/pri: Vidiots invites you to spend the night… with Mr. Darcy in this dreamy Jane Austen adaptation. A beautiful and enduring story of love and life among the landed English gentry during the Georgian era. Mr. Bennet is a gentleman living in Hertfordshire with his overbearing wife and five daughters, but if he dies their house will be inherited by a distant cousin whom they have never met, so the family’s future happiness and security is dependent on the daughters making good marriages. A love story for the ages, this gorgeous adaptation will still make your heart swell.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/pro: Escape to the hilariously switched-on world of Programme 4 , the groovy, feature-length “broadcast” from the Botany 500 Age of Television. Transmitting surreal local programming from the wall-to-wall carpeted dimension of Golden Sands — exclusively screened in-person for your analog pleasure with Programme 4 creator Rachel Lichtman and more special guests.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/psy: Join us for a full day of killer films that inspired Jane Schoenbrun’s Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma presented by our friends at MUBI.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/pum: Long live Pirate Radio and long live this bangin’ early 90s cult classic starring Christian Slater as a teenage airwave bandit! In Arizona, an introverted and insightful teenager, Mark Hunter (Christian Slater), finds an outlet for his viewpoints through a shortwave radio. Broadcasting as Hard Harry, Hunter uses his pirate radio show to rant against the injustices and hypocrisies taking place in the area, and in society in general. After a tragedy, his principal seeks to get Hunter off the air once and for all. So get ready to stick it to the man, and the FCC with this banger as we pump the killer soundtrack through our dynamite speaker system!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/ras: One of the most influential movies ever made, Rashomon is an enduring masterpiece that served as the big breakthrough for both legendary director Akira Kurosawa and charismatic star Toshirō Mifune, and introduced a radical new idea to cinema: telling the same story multiple times through the POV of different characters. Set in 11th century Kyoto, the plot centers on a grisly crime — a samurai is murdered and his wife assaulted by a bandit — that’s depicted via a series of flashbacks in which the participants each give their version of what happened. When their stories fail to match up, it’s left to the viewer to determine where exactly the truth lies. The first Japanese movie to win the Oscar for Best Foreign Language Film, this shapeshifting thriller has inspired countless imitators and even coined a psychological phenomenon called the “Rashomon Effect.”
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/rob: Vidiots is celebrating the 100th birthday of one of the greatest legends of comedy and cinema – the incomparable Mel Brooks – with a stupid fun screening of his ridiculous comedy classic Robin Hood: Men in Tights!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/rrr: Can’t stop! Won’t Stop! The biggest film of the decade has become a Vidiots tradition! RRR is an exhilarating, action-packed spectacular, starring two of India’s biggest superstars, N.T Rama Rao Jr., aka Jr NTR and Ram Charan. Set in the 1920s before their fight for India’s independence began, RRR imagines a fictional meeting between two real-life freedom fighters who helped lead India’s fight for independence from the British Raj.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/sca: Watch out for the double cross in Fritz Lang’s film noir classic Scarlet Street starring crime cinema’s crown prince Edward G. Robinson and the infectiously alluring Joan Bennett as the feisty femme fatale. Cashier and part-time starving artist Christopher Cross is absolutely smitten with the beautiful Kitty March. Kitty plays along, but she’s really only interested in Johnny, a two-bit crook. When Kitty and Johnny find out that art dealers are interested in Chris’s work, they con him into letting Kitty take credit for the paintings. Cross allows it because he is in love with Kitty, but his love will only let her get away with so much. A razor-sharp thriller with an abundance of artistic flourishes, plus wit and wisecracks, Scarlet Street is among Fritz Lang’s most entertaining masterpieces.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/sco: Vidiots is ecstatic to welcome director Edgar Wright for an evening of epic epicness starting with a screening of his beloved cult classic Scott Pilgrim vs. the World .
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/sex: Get ready for Steven Soderbergh’s Palme d’Or Winning feature debut masterpiece of sexuality and neuroses to hit our big screen! Ann, a frustrated wife, enters into counseling due to a troubled marriage. Unbeknownst to her, her husband John has begun an affair with her sister. When John’s best friend Graham arrives, his penchant for interviewing women about their sex lives forever changes John and Ann’s rocky marriage. An impressive debut by any standards, Soderbergh burst onto the scene at 26 with the sure hand of a fully-fledged master, and with this as his start, it’s no wonder he has become one of America’s most prolific auteurs – even if he tries to retire from time to time!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/spi: Discover friendship and freedom with this wild adventure on horseback! On a quiet starry night, the young and curious stallion, Spirit, is taken away from his herd of wild horses and embarks on an epic adventure across the frontiers of the American West. Facing the threat of losing his homeland and hostility from the U.S. Cavalry, he befriends a kindhearted Lakota, Little Creek, and his mysterious yet charming mare. Together they discover, within themselves, the true spirit of the Wild West. Featuring a riveting score by Hans Zimmer and songs by Bryan Adams, Spirit: Stallion of The Cimarron is sure to stir the hearts both young and old alike.

Join us for a screening of the universally acclaimed and beloved animated film Spirited Away from Studio Ghibli and Hayao Miyazaki. A young girl, Chihiro, becomes trapped in a strange new world of spirits. When her parents undergo a mysterious porcine transformation, she must call upon the courage she never knew she had to free her family. A visually astounding feat of imagination and heart, this early-2000s brilliant and beautiful film was the first non-English language film to win the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature and is considered one of the greatest animated films of all time.

Join us for a screening of the universally acclaimed and beloved animated film Spirited Away from Studio Ghibli and Hayao Miyazaki. A visually astounding feat of imagination and heart, this brilliant and beautiful film was the first non-English language film to win the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature and is considered one of the greatest animated films of all time.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/sta: I have been and always shall be your friend. Beam yourself up to the Starship Enterprise for a double shot of intergalactic fun and twice the Ricardo Montalban with one of the best films in the franchise, and an all-time classic of Science Fiction cinema Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan plus a bonus episode of the original series that inspired the film: Space Seed . Spock, Kirk, and the stalwart crew of the iconic Starship Enterprise are pulled back into action when old nemesis, the menacing villain Khan, steals a top-secret device called Project Genesis. Now the Enterprise is heading towards an intergalactic showdown in space! We’re setting our lasers (and projector) to stun!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/sto: Animation heads of all ages rejoice! We’ve got a supersized helping of adorable animated celluloid with Stop-Motion Explosion! , a program of delightful, mesmerizing, and mind-blowing stop-motion animation from the 1940s to the 1980s screening entirely on 16mm film on our big screen! In a world saturated with CGI, we’re opening the vaults to celebrate when historical, fantastical, and anthropomorphic creatures were hand-sculpted and manipulated into “life.”  This program of delightful shorts from around the world includes work by stop-motion pioneers George Pal, Karel Zeman, Art Clokey, Ladislas Starevich, Will Vinton, and visits from Paddington Bear, Frog and Toad, and more! Bring the kids or your besties for a show that’s millions of minute movements in the making! Everything screened on 16mm film from the Sweet 16mm collection.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/swe: We’re firing up our 16mm projector for a night of the best of puberty’s pitfalls and adolescence at its most awkward with a program of long-forgotten and laughably outdated short films from the 1940s through the 1980s about humanity’s cringiest life stage with menstrucation’s finest, endearing Mormon comedy shorts, mid-century slut-shaming primers, and more! Sex ed doesn’t get any better than Dear Diary: A Film About Female Puberty (1981) get ready to cheer for the chef’s kiss of endings.  The crowd-pleasing BYU comedy short The Phone Call (1977) wants you to know that even geeky, karate and bassoon-loving Mormon fast food workers deserve love, and with a little self-confidence and a great ginger-fro, they just might get it! Plus, another sensational menstrucational treat: Linda’s Film on Menstruation (1974) complete with a menstrual game show, the mid-century mental hygiene primer Are You Popular? (1958) to gently remind you to not slut it up, and a special surprise cartoon from the A/V Geeks Archive that will have you rethinking everything you knew about the mouse! Arrive early to explore all the gross but necessary things that happen to the growing boy in the third edition of Boy To Man (1984). You will laugh, you will cringe, you will finally learn all about your changing body! Everything screened on 16mm film.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/tee: Visionary director Jane Schoenbrun ( I Saw the TV Glow ) presents a new kind of horror remake in Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma . Bursting with imagination and surreal wit, their latest genre-bending wonder affirms there’s no such thing as a guilty pleasure.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/ter: One bad-ass mother of a sequel! The Governator is back and this time, he’s the good robot, sent from the future to protect John and Sarah Connor (Edward Furlong, Linda Hamilton) from an even deadlier terminator unit through the malls, warehouses, and dry riverbeds of early ’90s Los Angeles. A riotous good time for all, with pioneering special effects, and a timely message on Artificial Intelligence gone deadly, don’t miss this all-time banger on our big screen in glorious celluloid!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/the: The original night of terror in all its weird and twisted glory! Sam Raimi’s all-time horror classic is a smorgasbord of gory violence, guttural laughs, wildly inventive demons, and top-notch practical effects all helmed by the boundlessly charismatic Bruce Campbell. Five vacationing college students unwittingly resurrect demonic spirits through the Book of the Dead. Now there is no escape. The guilty must be punished.

Join us for Wong Kar-wai’s breathtaking martial arts spectacle in glorious celluloid! Ip Man’s peaceful life in Foshan changes after Gong Yutian seeks an heir for his family in Southern China. Ip Man then meets Gong Er who challenges him for the sake of regaining her family’s honor. After the Second Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man moves to Hong Kong and struggles to provide for his family. In the mean time, Gong Er chooses the path of vengeance after her father was killed by Ma San.

Jewel heists, intrigue, an all-star cast, and the eternal love story of a frog and a pig – this Muppetty installment has got it all! This time around, Kermit and Fozzie are newspaper reporters sent to London to interview Lady Holiday (The legendary Diana Rigg), a wealthy fashion designer whose priceless diamond necklace is stolen. Kermit meets and falls in love with her secretary, none other than that luminous porcine Miss Piggy. The jewel thieves strike again, and this time frame Miss Piggy. It’s up to Kermit and Muppets to bring the real culprits to justice.

Pack your bags for the head-trip of a lifetime with Alejandro Jodorowsky’s dazzling masterpiece and one of the most mind-bending feature films of all time. The Alchemist assembles together a group of people from all walks of life to represent the planets in the solar system. The occult adept’s intention is to put his recruits through strange mystical rites and divest them of their worldly baggage before embarking on a trip to Lotus Island. There they ascend the Holy Mountain to displace the immortal gods who secretly rule the universe. You’ll want to hold onto your eyeballs as you witness this psychedelic treasure on the big screen!

Does your summer need a little spice? Have we got the dinner party for you! Join us in the microcinema for Olivia Wilde’s wildly entertaining and perversely hilarious comedy The Invite for a fun and naughty night of indie cinema! Joe and Angela’s marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

Vidiots is excited to welcome writer/director Megan Griffiths for a special 15th Anniversary screening of her engaging character study The Off Hours followed by a conversation with Griffiths and cast members Amy Seimetz , Scoot McNairy, and Ross Partridge , moderated by Vidiots Founding Member Mark Duplass!

Join us in the microcinema for Kiyoshi Kurosawa’s ponderous and philosophical samurai epic The Samurai and the Prisoner. When Lord Murashige rises up against the tyrannical Oda, he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda’s army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei, a brilliant and dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon, as he must outwit his enemies and uncover the truth before time runs out.

We’re celebrating 100 years of one of the biggest icons of the silver screen – Marilyn Monroe – with a special screening of Billy Wilder’s hilarious classic comedy The Seven Year Itch . Laugh yourself silly with this beloved comedy of infatuation and infidelity starring Marilyn in her most-remembered roles (and dresses!). When his family goes away for summer vacation, a hitherto faithful publishing executive with an overactive imagination is tempted by an attractive new neighbor. With pitch-perfect delivery, and her effortless charm – not too mention her most notable pose on a sewer grate – it isn’t hard to see why Marilyn Monroe continues to captivate 100 years after her birth (as Norma Jean Baker) and over 60 years after her tragic death.

As the temperature rises, join us in the air conditioning for a chilling trip to Antarctica with one of the best horror/sci-fi films ever made. At a remote Antarctica outpost, a research team of misfits and malcontents comes under attack by a shape-shifting alien lifeform that had been trapped in the ice for 100,000 years. As the creature rages through the men, assuming one identity after another, the paranoia rises as the temperatures outside plummet. A fantastic cast, lead by the never-better Kurt Russell, amazing, now-legendary practical effects, and John Carpenter’s atmospheric direction make The Thing a chilling classic.

Join us for Carol Reed’s slick masterpiece of thrilling double-crosses, doomed love, and startling philosophy. Holly Martins, an author of pulp Westerns, arrives in postwar Vienna as a guest of his childhood chum Harry Lime, only to learn he has recently died. Martins stays around to investigate the death and finds everything isn’t what it seems. Joseph Cotton is the perfect patsy, Alida Valli is the gorgeous mystery, and Orson Welles is the smooth-talking devil twisting the rules to suit his own fortune. Often regarded as one of the best films of all time from the stunning cinematography, to the performances, to Welles’ adlibbed monologue on the Medicis and cuckoo clocks, The Third Man is every bit as good as the hype.

Grab the remote and change the station – it’s time for The Truman Show on our big beautiful screen. Jim Carrey plays America’s favorite reality star, only he doesn’t know how and when he signed up for the airtime! In a picture-perfect seaside town, an insurance salesman begins to realize that his entire existence may be staged and observed by a vast unseen audience as part of a long-running real-time reality TV show. A smart, funny, and endearing satire of celebrity culture and reality television with a killer cast and a soundtrack that includes tons of Phillip Glass, Peter Weir’s modern classic remains perennially relevant and rewatch-worthy.

With all this heat, we thought you might be thirsty for Philip Kaufman’s poetically polyamorous drama starring Daniel Day-Lewis, Lena Olin, and Juliette Binoche.  A film that paints the romantic and sexual tensions of three young gorgeous people onto the backdrop of Soviet imperialism of Eastern Europe in the 1960s and 1970s, Kaufman’s adaptation of the Milan Kundera novel explores interpersonal and international upheavals. Daniel Day-Lewis plays a Czech surgeon who uses his looks and charms to win over not one, but two stunning women who agree to move from one European country to another, in a tortured throuple thrust into the Soviet invasion of the former Czechoslovakia.

Join us for Amat Escalante’s mind- blowing, genre-bending tour-de-force, an unnerving, erotic, and chilling science fiction/ body horror/ existential thriller, you won’t want to miss on the big screen! Young mother Alejandra is a working housewife, raising two boys with husband Angel in a small city. Her brother Fabian works as a nurse in a local hospital. Their provincial lives are upset with the arrival of mysterious Veronica. Sex and love can be fragile in certain regions where strong family values, hypocrisy, homophobia, and male chauvinism exist. Veronica convinces them that in the nearby woods, inside an isolated cabin, dwells something not of this world that could be the answer to all of their problems. Something whose force they cannot resist and with whom they must make peace or suffer its wrath.

Slip into the dark and dreamy world of Sofia Coppola’s directorial debut based on the novel by Jeffrey Eugenides. Suburban Michigan, 1975. Cecilia, one of the five shadowy Lisbon sisters, attempts suicide—an event that unravels the lives of the Lisbon family. Little by little, the family shuts itself off from the world. With the girls forbidden to go out, an obsessed group of local boys plots to rescue them. A hypnotic and ethereal work supported by the sublime soundtrack from Air.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/tre: There’s something under the ground! An isolated town is on the menu for the giant, subterranean Graboids and it is up to Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Michael Gross, and Reba McEntire to get everyone out alive! With some of the best monster effects of the entire 1990s on full display in the desert sun, this cult-classic delivers the scares, thrills, and laughs of a creature feature that is truly Perfection.
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/twi: Vidiots is dying to welcome back director Catherine Hardwicke for the emo screening of your teen dreams – Twilight – followed by a conversation with Hardwicke on her undead phenomenon!

She’s dead… wrapped in plastic. If your summer plans call for an enigmatic journey to the Pacific Northwest and a small sleepy burg called Twin Peaks , have we got news for you! Go back to the beginning of David Lynch and Mark Frost’s game-changing television phenomenon with a special theatrical screening of the first two episodes of this landmark series on our beautiful big screen. When the homecoming queen washes ashore shrouded in a plastic coccoon, this small town is thrown into tragedy and panic. Luckily, the FBI’s most intriguing special agent, Dale Cooper, is on the case and vows to unravel this enduring mystery that extends beyond Twin Peaks and into the dark recesses of this universe and beyond. Whether you’re starting the show for the first time, or you’re revisiting for your twentieth, there’s nothing like seeing this dark, clever, mystical, metaphysical, and offbeat masterpiece at Vidiots!

https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/unb: M. Night Shyamalan twists the superhero genre into an introspective thriller in this genre-shattering slow burn. An ordinary man makes an extraordinary discovery when a train accident leaves his fellow passengers dead — and him unscathed. The answer to this mystery could lie with the mysterious Elijah Price, a man who suffers from a disease that renders his bones as fragile as glass. The closest cinema has come to picturing superheroes in real life, this banger is best on the big screen!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/vol: Join us for one of Pedro Almodóvar’s best dark comedies in all its colorful mastery in glorious 35mm film! From Academy Award-winner Pedro Almodóvar comes Volver , a darkly comedic and compassionate tribute to women and their resilience in the face of life’s most outrageous tribulations. A luminous Penélope Cruz leads an ensemble of gifted actresses, including Carmen Maura, star of Almodóvar’s Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown .
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/wel: Vidiots is thrilled to welcome writer/director Ngozi Onwurah for a special 30th Anniversary screening of her visionary Afrofuturist gem Welcome II the Terrordome !

The unbelievable but one-hundred percent true story of the Unarius Academy of Science —an extraterrestrial-channeling spiritual school in Southern California who in the 1980s became a prolific filmmaking collective and public access TV phenomenon under the direction of their outlandish spiritual leader Ruth E. Norman, AKA “Archangel Uriel.” Director Jodi Wille ( The Source Family ) brings this singular American story to the screen with the same wide-eyed fascination the subject demands. Engaging, enchanting, and extraterrestrial, Welcome Space Brothers is the most endearing cult documentary you’ve ever seen!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/wet: Vidiots is kvelling to welcome back writer/director David Wain and camp counselor Marguerite Moreau for a special 25th Anniversary screening of their cult comedy classic Wet Hot American Summer !
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/woo: We got you front row passes to the most legendary concert in American history – and you get to enjoy the whole thing in the air conditioning! An intimate look at the Woodstock Music & Art Festival held in Bethel, NY in 1969, from preparation through cleanup, with historic access to insiders, blistering concert footage, and portraits of the concertgoers; negative and positive aspects are shown, from drug use by performers to naked fans sliding in the mud, from the collapse of the fences by the unexpected hordes to the surreal arrival of National Guard helicopters with food and medical assistance for the impromptu city of 500,000. Join in on the musical mayhem on our big screen in glorious celluloid!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/yes: The iconic Michelle Yeoh teams up with the incredibly bad ass Cynthia Rothrock for one riotously fun martial arts action spectacular from Hong Kong legend Corey Yuen! Two unlucky thieves break into a just murdered man’s hotel room and steal his passport, with a hidden microfilm, wanted by a triad boss. Two ass-kicking women cops—one Chinese, one British—are on the case. A universally beloved action comedy with two of the coolest ladies of all time, this is going to be one hell of a Saturday night!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/yoj: Eternal icon Toshirō Mifune stars in this darkly comic and visually arresting masterpiece from the inimitable Akira Kurosawa. To rid a terror-stricken village of corruption, the wise ronin Sanjuro pits two evil clans against each other to his own advantage. Remade twice officially (which included a plagiarism lawsuit filed against Sergio Leone) with ripples of influence throughout the Western genre in both America and Italy, this exhilarating genre-twister remains one of the most influential and entertaining films of all time. Don’t miss all the samurai action you can handle on the big screen!
https://vidiotsfoundation.org/movies/you: We’re electrifying the ab(by)- normal and Putting on the Ritz with this unbelievably hilarious spoof on the classic tale of reanimation and misunderstanding. Gene Wilder plays the neurosurgeon descendent of the mythical Dr. Frankenstein. After stumbling on his original plans, the young Dr. Frankenstein (pronounced fronkenshteen) attempts to play God once again and bring a corpse back from the dead. With some of the funniest lines in cinema history and brilliant performances from Wilder, Cloris Leachman, Marty Feldman and Teri Garr, Young Frankenstein remains one of Mel Brooks’ greatest triumphs.
